content: From the results it seems that the DSL 2017 task might be harder than the DSL 2015 and NCHLT tasks. Also, the results for the implementation discussed in BIBREF23 might seem low, but the results reported in that paper is generated on longer pieces of text so lower scores on the shorter pieces of text derived from the NCHLT corpora is expected.
